name: Enterprise Data Architecture Lens
description: Evaluates whether a solution is sufficiently aligned with Enterprise Data Architecture principles.

pillars.name: Enterprise Data Architecture
pillars.description: Checks whether business context, data objects, authoritative sources and reusable access paths are sufficiently understood before introducing new data integrations.

questions.title: Is the Business Context known and defined?
questions.description: Verify that the relevant Legal Entity, Location, Business Capability, Business Process and Business Data Objects are identified.

choices.title: Yes
choices.description: The relevant business context and Business Data Objects are known and documented.

choices.title: Partially
choices.description: Some elements of the business context are known, but important elements are still unclear.

choices.title: No
choices.description: The solution is primarily described from a technical perspective without sufficient business context.

questions.title: Are the Business Data Objects sufficiently qualified?
questions.description: Verify that the relevant Business Data Objects are maintained in Collibra and that definitions, ownership, policies and semantic relationships are available and current.

choices.title: Yes
choices.description: The relevant BDOs are sufficiently documented and governed.

choices.title: Partially
choices.description: The BDOs exist, but metadata, policies, ownership or semantic relationships are incomplete.

choices.title: No
choices.description: The required Business Data Objects are not sufficiently described or governed.

questions.title: Does a qualified access path to the required Business Data Objects already exist?
questions.description: Check whether an existing Data Product, ESB API, eVa integration or another governed access path can provide the required data.

choices.title: Yes
choices.description: A suitable governed access path already exists.

choices.title: Partially
choices.description: Existing access paths cover parts of the requirement but require extension or clarification.

choices.title: No
choices.description: No suitable governed access path has been identified.

questions.title: Is the authoritative source for the required data clear?
questions.description: Verify that the authoritative source or System of Record for the required Business Data Objects is known.

choices.title: Yes
choices.description: The authoritative source is clearly identified.

choices.title: Partially
choices.description: The source is known for parts of the required data, but ambiguities remain.

choices.title: No
choices.description: The solution relies on data whose authoritative source is unclear.

questions.title: Can existing enterprise data assets be reused?
questions.description: Verify that existing Data Products, APIs, integrations and semantic assets have been evaluated before creating a new data flow or copy.

choices.title: Yes
choices.description: Existing enterprise assets can satisfy the requirement.

choices.title: Partially
choices.description: Existing assets can be reused but require extension.

choices.title: No
choices.description: A genuine capability gap exists and a new enterprise asset is required.
